name: 32502 · Pensacola, FL
findings: ZIP 32502 (Pensacola) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32502 (Pensacola) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32502 (Pensacola) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 9.6 times the typical level).
